fields.v: Not an SDD approach. Yuj coding-agent harness (author's, github.com/sydches/yuj; version Not stated): treatment package = half-life working-view rule (older tool results shortened in stages once prompt reaches 50% of window) + stall detector with fixed interventions + command safeguards; control = same harness with full chronological transcript. Pro and FeatureBench pressure runs used an earlier frozen treatment version
None (no specification or context file); harness keeps a complete run record (trace and transcript files) separate from the model's working view

Existing code bases: repository-level issue resolution and feature development (SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Pro, FeatureBench)
SWE-bench Verified 169 tasks (from a 187-task pressure pool); SWE-bench Pro 316 demand-screened tasks; FeatureBench 183 canonical tasks; Verified 11 repos, Pro 11, FeatureBench 22
Open-source repositories of the benchmarks (e.g. django, tutanota, qutebrowser); languages Not stated

Context-pressure share (control runs filling the window); reading boundary (demand/window ratio at 50% probability of stopping before first source change); shortening activity (active runs, first turn, typical reduction); detector and safeguard event counts

Automatic: benchmark evaluators and tests, harness traces; exact McNemar (resolution) and exact sign tests (F2PF direction), paired-task bootstrap 95% intervals, repository-cluster bootstrap (20,000 resamples) with Holm correction; logistic fit for reading boundary

Harness: Yuj (control vs treatment). Qwen3.6 served locally with llama-server, 4-bit Q4 K XL weights; transfer models each with a declared four-bit weight file and model-specific serving settings; greedy decoding; one trajectory per task per arm. Criterion: evaluator tests (resolution, F2PF). Verdicts judged per arm on its own (quality: share of tasks resolved, >=50% works, 20-50% partly, <20% does not work; cost: absolute turns/tokens/wall time where reported, local 4-bit serving, fixed 480-s attempt budget).
- Control + Yuj + Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Verified 20,480: F2PF 28.0%, 43/169 solved; 3,280 turns, 37.8M prompt tokens, 1.3 h. Quality partly; cost works
- Treatment + Yuj + Qwen3.6, Verified 20,480: F2PF 49.1%, 72/169 (34:5, p<0.0001); 6,517 turns, 80.7M tokens, 4.6 h. Quality partly; cost works
- Control + Qwen3.6, Verified 43,008: F2PF 53.8%, 76/169. Quality partly; cost Not stated
- Treatment + Qwen3.6, Verified 43,008: F2PF 60.1% (sign test p=0.0708), 87/169 (McNemar p=0.0614). Quality works; cost Not stated
- Control + Qwen3.6, Verified 262,144: F2PF 69.0%, 102/169. Quality works; cost Not stated
- Treatment + Qwen3.6, Verified 262,144: F2PF 68.7%, 101/169; 7.2% fewer prompt tokens per turn than control (geometric mean 0.928). Quality works; cost Not stated in absolute terms
- Control + Qwen3.6, Pro 49,152: F2PF 15.2%, 31/316; 8,357 turns, 210.6M tokens, 5.4 h. Quality does not work; cost works
- Treatment + Qwen3.6, Pro 49,152: F2PF 32.7%, 72/316 (47:6, p<0.0001); 25,750 turns, 657.1M tokens, 21.8 h. Quality partly; cost works
- Control + Qwen3.6, Pro 262,144: F2PF 44.8%, 101/316. Quality partly; cost Not stated
- Treatment + Qwen3.6, Pro 262,144 (earlier package): F2PF 44.5%, 99/316. Quality partly; cost Not stated
- Control + Qwen3.6, FeatureBench 47,104: F2PF 10.5%, 2/183; 5,281 turns, 140.3M tokens, 2.5 h. Quality does not work; cost works
- Treatment + Qwen3.6, FeatureBench 47,104: F2PF 19.6% (p<0.0001), 3/183; 15,178 turns, 412.8M tokens, 14.7 h. Quality does not work (F2PF gain only); cost works
- Control + Qwen3.6, FeatureBench 262,144: F2PF 23.9%, 5/183. Quality does not work; cost Not stated
- Treatment + Qwen3.6, FeatureBench 262,144 (earlier package): F2PF 30.7% (p=0.00022; repository-level p=0.0963), 5/183. Quality does not work; cost Not stated
- Control + Devstral 2, Verified 20,480: F2PF 17.2%, 22/169. Quality does not work; cost Not stated
- Treatment + Devstral 2, Verified 20,480: F2PF 36.8%, 53/169 (p<0.0001). Quality partly; cost Not stated
- Control + Nemotron-Cascade 2, Verified 20,480: F2PF 12.0%, 16/169. Quality does not work; cost Not stated
- Treatment + Nemotron-Cascade 2, Verified 20,480: F2PF 18.3% (p=0.0169), 25/169 (p=0.0636). Quality does not work; cost Not stated
- Control + Qwen3.8-27B, Verified 20,480: F2PF 20.4%, 32/169. Quality does not work; cost Not stated
- Treatment + Qwen3.8-27B, Verified 20,480: F2PF 35.3%, 54/169 (p<0.0001). Quality partly; cost Not stated
- Exploratory probes (ablation, 15 tasks, single runs): altered caps/activation never beat frozen settings (Qwen3.6 caps x0.5 5/15, x2.0 4/15 vs 6-7/15 frozen; Qwen3.6 timing probes 1-3/15; Devstral 1-2/15; Nemotron 0-1/15; Table 18 jumbled, mapped by row order). Quality partly (Qwen3.6 depth probes) to does not work (timing probes, Devstral, Nemotron); cost Not stated
- Control-credibility check: untreated Yuj vs mini-SWE-agent v2.2.8 with GPT-5.5 via Codex CLI on 500 Verified tasks: 87.6% outcome agreement (kappa 0.66); resolution rates and cost Not stated

rev.why: Draft said all models used llama-server with Q4 K XL weights; the text states that only for the primary Qwen3.6 runs (p. 5, 16); transfer models used their own declared four-bit weight files and model-specific profiles and serving settings (p. 12, 19). All metric values check against Tables 7-9, 11 and 18. The works/partly verdicts (e.g. control 'cost works' because it stops early) are the draft's judgement

Several entries had no verdict for the control arm (43k, 262k, Pro, FeatureBench, transfer models), and the verdicts given were relative to the other arm (e.g. control 'cost works (stops early)', treatment 'cost partly (2x+ work)', 'No difference'), against §6 (each configuration judged on its own). Rebuilt as one entry per arm with its own quality and cost verdict; metric values unchanged and re-checked against Tables 7-9, 11 (pp. 17-19); added Pro T-only:C-only 47:6 (Table 7) and the Devstral/Nemotron/timing probe counts from Table 18 (p. 23, jumbled, mapped by row order). The resolution-share cut (>=50% / 20-50% / <20%) is the verifier's; the paper gives no success threshold, so the author should confirm it

fields.v: Paired: every task run once under control and once under treatment; same task, model weights, context capacity, tool interface, serving, evaluator, harness code; differ only in one checked-in configuration package. Context windows varied (Verified 20,480 / 43,008 / 262,144; Pro 49,152 / 262,144; FeatureBench 47,104 / 262,144). Baseline: control configuration. Acceptance tests: benchmark F2P tests. Repetitions: 1 greedy trajectory per arm. Human intervention: none. Isolation: no network, no gold patches. Operating point set during earlier development on same benchmark families (not held-out)

Under context pressure treatment beats control on F2PF in all three benchmarks (Verified +21.1 pp [14.1, 28.3], Pro +17.5, FeatureBench +9.1; all p<0.0001) and on resolution on Verified (+29 tasks) and Pro (+41); after Holm (repository level) Verified and FeatureBench resolution not significant. Gains shrink with window size; near zero at 262,144 on Verified and Pro. Transfer: gains for all models (1.5x-2.1x F2PF). Reading boundary stretched 2.21-2.53x. Treatment used 2-6x more turns/tokens/time under pressure

Yes: paired design distinguished configurations under pressure; not under ample context. Repeatable: single greedy trajectory per arm, run-to-run variation not measured; Verified windows collected successively (window confounded with run era); Pro/FeatureBench wide-window rows from earlier packages. Limitation stated: estimates the whole package, not single rules; not compute-matched

Effect of the whole treatment package only; not compute-matched; one trajectory per arm; four locally served 4-bit open-weight models (no hosted frontier models); repository-level coding tasks only; no human quality judgment; shared pretraining exposure; compared only with full-transcript control, not summaries or retrieval. Future: detector-only component study, time-only variation, adaptive harness, read caching, model design x context

Yuj harness, configs, experimental contract, provenance and paired task outcomes public (github.com/sydches/yuj); benchmark lists, evaluators and raw runs not public. Pre-registration claimed for transfer comparisons ('pre-registered Devstral-Nemotron family', separately registered Qwen3.8), no registry link. Several appendix tables jumbled in text extraction: Tables 9, 15, 16-18 rebuilt from row order (Table 15: Verified control 0.71, treatment 1.81, stretch 2.53; Pro 0.97/2.15/2.21; FeatureBench 0.93/2.09/2.26).
